boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Documented SUNY Oneonta spaces for individual reading, technology work, and collaboration.

cards.title: Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Milne Library • first floor
cards.notes: Bring print reading or a laptop to the first-floor reading room, across from Argo Tea, and use its comfortable seating and current periodicals.
cards.short_summary: First-floor library seating beside current newspapers and periodicals.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta identifies the Milne Library Reading Room as a first-floor space with comfortable seating and current print periodicals and newspapers.
cards.access_notes: Use during Milne Library's current open hours and follow posted library rules.

cards.title: Social Zone
cards.subtitle: Milne Library • first-floor group work
cards.notes: Meet classmates in the colorful first-floor Social Zone for a collaborative session, keeping conversation and shared materials contained to your group.
cards.short_summary: A colorful Milne Library setting designed for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta describes the first-floor Social Zone in Milne Library as a colorful, comfortable space for group work.
cards.access_notes: Use during Milne Library's current open hours and follow posted library rules.

cards.title: Group Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Milne Library • collaborative rooms
cards.notes: Use a group meeting room when your project needs a defined place to compare notes, rehearse a presentation, or work through shared documents.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated Milne Library rooms for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists dynamic group meeting rooms among Milne Library's renovated facilities.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current room-use procedures with Milne Library; library open hours apply.

cards.entity_name: Computer and Technology Labs, Milne Library
cards.title: Computer and Technology Labs
cards.subtitle: Milne Library • technology-enabled work
cards.notes: Choose the library's computer and technology labs for assignments that need campus equipment, then save your work to cloud storage or personal media.
cards.short_summary: Technology-equipped library work areas for computer-based coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta identifies cutting-edge computer and technology labs as part of Milne Library's facilities.
cards.access_notes: Equipment availability may vary; use during current library hours and ask library staff for assistance.

cards.title: Alden Room
cards.subtitle: Milne Library • third-floor archival materials
cards.notes: Plan a primary-source research visit around the third-floor Alden Room, where campus photographs, documents, and artifacts support local institutional study.
cards.short_summary: An archival room holding SUNY Oneonta photographs, documents, and artifacts.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta states that the third-floor Alden Room contains historic SUNY Oneonta photos, documents, and other artifacts.
cards.access_notes: Ask library staff about current access and handling procedures for archival materials.

cards.title: Quiet Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Milne Library • focused individual work
cards.notes: Set up in one of Milne's quiet study areas for reading, drafting, or problem sets, and keep calls and group conversation in other library zones.
cards.short_summary: Quiet library areas intended for concentrated solo coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists quiet study areas among Milne Library's recently renovated facilities.
cards.access_notes: Use during Milne Library's current open hours and observe posted quiet-area expectations.

cards.title: Plant Wall
cards.subtitle: Physical Science Building • reading break setting
cards.notes: Bring a book or course packet to the plant wall area in Physical Science for a short reading session between classes and leave the display undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A campus indoor reading setting distinguished by its plant wall.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta suggests reading a book by the plant wall in the Physical Science Building.
cards.access_notes: Building access follows current university building hours and operational conditions.

cards.title: Living Room
cards.subtitle: Hunt Union • views of Hunt Union Pond
cards.notes: Use the Hunt Union Living Room for independent reading or laptop work while taking in views of Hunt Union Pond; keep pathways and shared seating open.
cards.short_summary: A Hunt Union common area overlooking the campus pond.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta identifies the Living Room inside Hunt Union as a place to take in views of Hunt Union Pond.
cards.access_notes: Use during Hunt Union's current building hours and respect event or student-organization use of common areas.

cards.title: International Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hunt Union • pond-view common area
cards.notes: Choose the International Lounge for a change of scenery while reviewing course materials, and share seating courteously when the lounge is active.
cards.short_summary: A Hunt Union lounge with views toward Hunt Union Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists the International Lounge inside Hunt Union among places to take in views of Hunt Union Pond.
cards.access_notes: Use during Hunt Union's current building hours and respect event or student-organization use of common areas.

cards.title: Ford Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Ford Hall • residential individual and group study
cards.notes: Residents can use Ford Hall's floor study rooms for individual or group coursework, coordinating with hallmates and following residence-hall access rules.
cards.short_summary: Residential study rooms with individual and group work space on each floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta states that Ford Hall has study rooms on each floor with individual and group study space.
cards.access_notes: Ford Hall is a residence hall; access is restricted to residents and authorized guests under university residence-hall rules.
